headline: Hermes Reports 5.5% Q3 Sales Growth Led by Leather Goods and Americas
summary: Hermes reported a 5.5% increase in third-quarter revenue, underpinned by continued resilient demand for its leather goods segment and expanding sales across the Americas.
why: Hermes International is a global luxury benchmark whose performance serves as a bellwether for high-end consumer discretionary spending.

impacts.name: Hermes International
impacts.why: Third-quarter revenue expanded by 5.5%, demonstrating enduring demand for core luxury leather goods.
